description: Bâtiments municipaux is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Inventaire des ouvrages municipaux de la Ville de Montréal, dont elle est propriétaire ou locataire. On y retrouve plus de 75 types d’usages immobiliers qui catégorisent l’ensemble des bâtiments et des installations externes, notamment des arénas, des bibliothèques, des casernes de pompiers, des centres culturels, des chalets, des jeux d’eau et des piscines extérieures. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Aréna, Bibliothèque, Caserne de pompiers, Centre culturel, Chalet. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
